notes: Macro definition copied verbatim from macros/smile_attr_var.sas. The repo's own test program only ever prints the macro's return values via %PUT (log output). This bundle instead collects the macro's return values for two sashelp.class variables (name, age; the same two the repo's test program uses) into a small dataset and PROC PRINTs it, so the macro's actual results are visible in the run's listing output.
